headline: Close the last flaky trial's dq-4 with mechanical enforcement of both grader-quoted recording shapes: validator checks 6 (re-split triggers) and 7 (bare-pointer bundling), review Criterion-3 scoring calibration, worked examples, and paste-ready fix templates

clusters.name: acknowledged epic-size overage without a re-split trigger (dq 4)
clusters.detail: case-030 t0 kept E001 (~1.25-1.5 sprints) above the ~2-week guideline as a bare 'flagged for planning awareness only' Health Warning; the internal review docked Criterion 3 to 1/2 and demanded an un-actionable split, whose execution left the overage unresolved and injected a DAG violation the re-review failed; the external grader docked exactly this ('the size remains above guideline, which the embedded adversarial review also docked'). Passing siblings record a trigger/watch item (t2: 're-split if the audit exceeds the 75% estimate') and score 5/5 with 14/14 internal reviews.

clusters.name: justified P1-into-P0 bundling recorded as a bare pointer off-matrix
clusters.detail: HLR-7's bundling rationale lived in a bare-pointer sentence after the matrix ('bundled with P0 work per the tight-coupling rule above'); the graders' 5/5 rationales quote the on-the-record shapes (t1: matrix row 'E001 (bundled)' with inline rationale; t2: labeled Step-4 priority-split analysis). A self-contained off-matrix note is also compliant (case-018 t2, 5/5).
